title: 用量批次冪等、亂序缺口、衝突稽核與簽章檢查點恢復 (Idempotent Usage Ingest, Contiguous ACK, Conflict Audit & Signed Checkpoint Recovery)
expected: POST /api/v1/agent/usage-batches enforces idempotent batch replay, per-event duplicate/conflict/rejected status, contiguous ACK watermark (highest_contiguous_seq & blocked_seq), >2^53 decimal string precision, and Ed25519-signed GET /api/v1/agent/usage-checkpoint recovery with fvpn-usage-admin freeze/begin-recovery/complete-recovery.
actual: Live mTLS /api/v1/agent/usage-checkpoint and /api/v1/agent/usage-batches on serving node 01a18e52-b663-70aa-858c-12d0cd359d20 (incarnation 01a18e52-b696-70ca-8f8c-c9cb0c48342c) verified real agent-uploaded ledger events (1..97), bound member UsageRecord ingestion, out-of-order {98,100} -> gap fill 99 advancing highest_contiguous_seq to 100, batch/event replay with zero double-counting, payload_sha256 conflict audit (rows=2), rejected >2^53 event blocked_seq=102 advancing to 103, and live §17.3 ledger recovery via fvpn-usage-admin (freeze 503, begin-recovery epoch 01a18e96-de19-7b88-b05a-b8b6af754868 -> 01a18eb9-f7e5-768b-a228-6798c0824bab, replay_unavailable seq 104 tombstone, and complete-recovery).

commands.command: POST /api/v1/admin/policies (dns_profile, fair_use shadow, plan with exit_group_ids) + POST /activate
PATCH /api/v1/admin/nodes/{id} + PUT /publication + JoinNativeMember(memberA, memberB) + netbird networks select fvpn-exit-3b8c7fda8e7fc29ea530aef8
Baseline counted HTTPS probe through exit node (member -> fvnb0 -> fvmb0 -> fvup0 -> origin)
mTLS POST /api/v1/agent/usage-batches (out-of-order {98,100}, gap fill 99, conflict 100, blocked 102->103, 409/403 guards)
fvpn-usage-admin freeze + begin-recovery + mTLS GET /usage-checkpoint + POST /usage-batches (replay_unavailable) + complete-recovery

mechanism_checks.name: LiveMTLSUsageBatchesContiguousAckConflictBlockedSeqAndRecoveryMode
mechanism_checks.summary: Live mTLS /api/v1/agent/usage-batches and fvpn-usage-admin verified bound member UsageRecord ingestion, out-of-order {98,100}->99 contiguous ACK, idempotent batch/event replay with zero double-counting, payload_sha256 conflict audit, rejected >2^53 blocked_seq=102->103, freeze (503), begin-recovery epoch bump (01a18e96-de19-7b88-b05a-b8b6af754868->01a18eb9-f7e5-768b-a228-6798c0824bab), replay_unavailable tombstone (seq 104), and complete-recovery.

mechanism_checks.name: ContiguousAckAndDecimalStringPrecisionAbove2Pow53
mechanism_checks.summary: Out-of-order sequences {1, 3} hold highest_contiguous_seq at 1 with missing_ranges=[{2,2}] until seq 2 arrives (advancing to 3); 2^53+1 (9007199254740993) and 2^53+3 (9007199254740995) round-trip as exact decimal strings.

mechanism_checks.name: DuplicateBatchLostAckAndConflictBlockedSeq
mechanism_checks.summary: Batch resends and lost-ACK retries never double-count bytes; conflicting payload_sha256 records usage_event_conflicts and rejected events set blocked_seq=6 while holding highest_contiguous_seq=5.

mechanism_checks.name: CentralDBRestoreSignedCheckpointAndReplayReconciliation
mechanism_checks.summary: FreezeIngest returns 503; BeginRecovery rotates ledger_epoch with a signed PurposeLedgerEpoch record; old epoch batches return 409 LEDGER_EPOCH_MISMATCH; Ed25519-verified PurposeRecovery checkpoint guides replay_unavailable tombstone reconciliation without inventing bytes.
